segments.en: I know what you're going to say.
segments.zh: 我知道你要说什么。

segments.en: OK, so he's essentially saying, I know you're going to try and sell me a computer.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以他基本上是在说，我知道你会试着卖给我一台电脑。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you can use it in other circumstances, right?
segments.zh: 所以你可以在其他情况下使用它，对吧？

segments.en: For example, a relationship.
segments.zh: 例如，一种关系。

segments.en: I don't know where this is going.
segments.zh: 我不知道这是怎么回事。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: What is going?
segments.zh: 发生了什么事？

segments.en: Classic breakup line.
segments.zh: 经典的分手台词。

segments.en: I just don't think I know where this is going anymore.
segments.zh: 我只是想我不知道这是怎么回事了。

segments.en: So in reference to the relationship, right?
segments.zh: 所以在谈到关系时，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: We don't know what's happening.
segments.zh: 我们不知道发生了什么。

segments.en: Are we serious?
segments.zh: 我们是认真的吗？

segments.en: Are we maybe going to get married?
segments.zh: 我们可能要结婚了吗？

segments.en: I don't know anymore.
segments.zh: 我不知道了。

segments.en: I can't tell where this movie is going.
segments.zh: 我不知道这部电影的去向。

segments.en: It's so like, oh, here and there and boring.
segments.zh: 就像，哦，到处都是无聊的。

segments.en: You don't know the plot.
segments.zh: 你不知道剧情。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So it's a very common phrase and it sounds very natural when you say it, right?
segments.zh: 所以这是一个非常常见的短语，当你说它时听起来很自然，对吧？

segments.en: It does.
segments.zh: 是的，听起来很自然。

segments.en: And that's why as an influency builder, it really helps you sound like a more native English speaker when you use these kind of phrases.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么作为一个有影响力的建设者，当你使用这些短语时，它真的可以帮助你听起来更像一个以英语为母语的人。

segments.en: And the next one is also very, very good.
segments.zh: 下一张也非常非常好。

segments.en: When he describes the condition of the computer, he says it's top of the line.
segments.zh: 他描述这台电脑时，说它是 top of the line（顶级配置）。

segments.en: Top of the line.
segments.zh: 顶级。

segments.en: Now, what line we're talking about, I do not know, but this is above average line, right?
segments.zh: 现在，我们在谈论什么线，我不知道，但这高于平均线，对吧？

segments.en: So this is the best of the best.
segments.zh: 所以这是最好的。

segments.en: This is the top model or the top computer.
segments.zh: 这是顶级型号或顶级计算机。

segments.en: And you can definitely imagine a car salesman using this.
segments.zh: 你绝对可以想象一个汽车推销员使用它。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: This BMW is top line.
segments.zh: 这辆宝马是顶级的。

segments.en: It's the best money can buy.
segments.zh: 这是钱能买到的最好的。

segments.en: That's another good one.
segments.zh: 这又是一个好短语。

segments.en: So basically top of the line is the best of the best.
segments.zh: 所以基本上顶级是最好的。

segments.en: The above average, right?
segments.zh: 高于平均水平，对吧？

segments.en: More than above average.
segments.zh: 高于平均水平。

segments.en: It's really it's the best you can do.
segments.zh: 这真的是你能做的最好的。

segments.en: And so the guy is saying, listen, this is our best computer.
segments.zh: 所以那家伙说，听着，这是我们最好的电脑。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: You should buy it.
segments.zh: 你应该买它。

segments.en: And obviously, you have the line.
segments.zh: 显然，你有这条线。

segments.en: It's a lot of money.
segments.zh: 这是一大笔钱。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's usually for something that costs money, right?
segments.zh: 它通常用来形容花钱的东西，对吧？

segments.en: For things you wouldn't really use it for a person, right?
segments.zh: 你不会用它来形容一个人，对吧？

segments.en: He's top of the line.
segments.zh: 他是顶级的。

segments.en: No, no, no, no, no.
segments.zh: 不，不，不，不，不。

segments.en: Top of the line, I think generally refers to electronics and cars or like motorcycles.
segments.zh: top of the line 一般是指电子产品、汽车之类的，或者摩托车。

segments.en: And so you often hear top of the line stereo, top line TV, top of the line car.
segments.zh: 所以你经常听到顶级音响、顶级电视、顶级汽车。

segments.en: But you wouldn't say this about food or people or art.
segments.zh: 但你不会说关于食物、人或艺术的话。

segments.en: Yeah, you wouldn't say this.
segments.zh: 是的，你不会这么说。

segments.en: This painting is top of the line.
segments.zh: 这幅画是顶级的。

segments.en: Not about like very unique things.
segments.zh: 不是说很独特的东西。

segments.en: You'd say this about kind of manufactured things.
segments.zh: 你会用它来形容那种批量生产的东西。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So we've taken a look at a lot of great phrases.
segments.zh: 所以我们看了很多很棒的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to our dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back.
segments.zh: 为什么我们不听我们最后一次的对话，然后我们会回来。

segments.en: So can you fix it?
segments.zh: 那么你能修复它吗？

segments.en: I'm sorry, sir.
segments.zh: 对不起，先生。

segments.en: This computer is not broken or damaged.
segments.zh: 这台电脑没坏，也没有受损。

segments.en: It's simply just too old.
segments.zh: 它只是太老了。

segments.en: That's why your programs and applications are running slow.
segments.zh: 这就是您的程序和应用程序运行缓慢的原因。

segments.en: There really isn't much I can do.
segments.zh: 我真的无能为力。

segments.en: What do you mean?
segments.zh: 你是什么意思？

segments.en: I bought this computer just three years ago.
segments.zh: 三年前我买了这台电脑。

segments.en: Yes, but technology is ever changing and technology is becoming obsolete faster and faster.
segments.zh: 是的，但技术日新月异，设备淘汰得也越来越快。

segments.en: Okay, I know where this is going.
segments.zh: 好吧，我知道你接下来要说什么了。

segments.en: How much will it cost me to get a new computer?
segments.zh: 买一台新电脑要花多少钱？

segments.en: Well, this desktop over here is our latest model.
segments.zh: 这台台式机是我们的最新型号。

segments.en: It has a 4 gigahertz processor with 16 gigabytes in RAM and a hard disk with one terabyte.
segments.zh: 它有一个 4 吉赫兹处理器，16 GB 内存，硬盘 1 TB。

segments.en: Of course, it includes a mouse, keyboard, and desk speakers.
segments.zh: 当然，它包括鼠标、键盘和桌面扬声器。

segments.en: I have no idea what you are talking about.
segments.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。

segments.en: I just want to know if it's good and if I'll be able to play Solitaire without the computer crashing or freezing all the time.
segments.zh: 我只想知道它好不好，能不能让我玩纸牌接龙时不会老是崩溃或卡死。

segments.en: This PC is top of the line and I guarantee it will never freeze.
segments.zh: 这台电脑是顶级配置，我保证它绝不会卡住。

segments.en: If it does, we'll give you your money back.
segments.zh: 要是卡住了，我们就给您退款。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So computers, Catherine, I know you recently got a nice Macintosh.
segments.zh: 所以电脑，凯瑟琳，我知道你最近有一个不错的 Macintosh。

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, I did.
segments.zh: 是的，是的，我做到了。

segments.en: It's one of those big screen ones, right?
segments.zh: 这是那些大屏幕的之一，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, it is.
segments.zh: 对，确实是。

segments.en: It's a desktop, right?
segments.zh: 是桌面吧？

segments.en: So it's not a laptop and it's got a very fast processor because Macs started using Intel processors a couple of years ago and that made them much faster.
segments.zh: 所以它不是一台笔记本电脑，它有一个非常快的处理器，因为 Mac 几年前开始使用英特尔处理器，这使得它们更快。

segments.en: Wow, and it has, this processor actually has two cores, right?
segments.zh: 哇，它有，这个处理器实际上有两个内核，对吧？

segments.en: So basically it has two different brains almost within one processor.
segments.zh: 所以基本上它几乎在一个处理器中有两个不同的大脑。

segments.en: Which gives it really bad headaches.
segments.zh: 这给它带来了非常严重的头痛。

segments.en: She complains to me often.
segments.zh: 她经常向我抱怨。

segments.en: Are you a big Mac fan or PC fan?
segments.zh: 你是 Mac 铁杆粉还是 PC 粉？

segments.en: I'm a Mac fan.
segments.zh: 我是Mac粉丝。

segments.en: I've been converted.
segments.zh: 我已经转换了。

segments.en: My roommate in college, my sophomore year, had a Mac and ever since then I've really gotten into them.
segments.zh: 我大二时的大学室友有一台 Mac，从那时起我就迷上 Mac 了。

segments.en: So, yeah, I went Mac and didn't turn back.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，我去了 Mac 并没有回头。

segments.en: I still honestly cannot really use a Mac.
segments.zh: 老实说，我仍然无法真正使用 Mac。

segments.en: I get confused.
segments.zh: 我很困惑。

segments.en: I'm looking for the start button and I'm looking for where my documents are.
segments.zh: 我正在寻找开始按钮，我正在寻找我的文档在哪里。

segments.en: It's really hard to change over, right?
segments.zh: 真的很难改变，对吧？

segments.en: But once you do, you don't want to change back because everything is so much easier on a Mac.
segments.zh: 但是一旦你这样做了，你就不想改回来，因为 Mac 上的一切都变得容易得多。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: But if you're really into PC gaming, then you should probably stick with it.
segments.zh: 但如果你真的喜欢 PC 游戏，那么你可能应该坚持下去。

segments.en: Stick with the PCs because the games just don't really compare on Macs.
segments.zh: 坚持使用 PC，因为游戏在 Mac 上并没有真正比较。

segments.en: But I've heard that also Macs don't really suffer from viruses, right?
segments.zh: 但我听说 Mac 也不会真正感染病毒，对吧？

segments.en: No, they don't, which is great.
segments.zh: 不，他们没有，这很棒。

segments.en: Because I always used to get these viruses that would float on my computer because you know you open some email and all of a sudden there's nastiness on your desktop.
segments.zh: 因为我以前老是中病毒，它们会在电脑里乱窜——你打开某封邮件，桌面上就突然冒出乱七八糟的东西。

segments.en: Well now I don't really have that problem.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我真的没有这个问题。

segments.en: And also there's really wonderful photo editing software and video editing software.
segments.zh: 还有非常棒的照片编辑软件和视频编辑软件。

segments.en: So everything is just really easy to find and easy to use.
segments.zh: 因此，一切都非常容易找到且易于使用。

segments.en: What about you listeners?
segments.zh: 你的听众呢？

segments.en: Do you prefer the Mac?
segments.zh: 你更喜欢Mac吗？

segments.en: Do you prefer the PC?
segments.zh: 你更喜欢 PC 吗？

segments.en: Or maybe some of our listeners don't really even like computers.
segments.zh: 或者也许我们的一些听众甚至不喜欢电脑。

segments.en: So let us know either way, we're very curious to hear what you have to say.
segments.zh: 所以无论哪种方式，让我们知道，我们很想知道你要说什么。

segments.en: And of course, writing on our comments section is great practice for your English.
segments.zh: 当然，在我们的评论区留言是练习英语的好方法。

segments.en: Right, so we'll see you guys there and until next time.
segments.zh: 对，我们在那里见，下次见。

segments.en: Bye everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye now.
segments.zh: 现在再见。
